name: Artifact Seeker: Paladin
storyline: Amelia, renowned as a paragon among Paladins, is famed for her exquisite mastery of Holy magic and her impregnable counter-defensive tactics. On the battlefield, even the most ferocious of attacks can scarcely bring her to her knees. She always manages to rise from adversity, reorganize the ranks, and with her indomitable will and sacred power, she safeguards her companions and their faith. Immerse yourself in RPG-like events, make diverse choices, venture into treacherous dungeons, and explore magical worlds. Befriend different heroes and unlock new characters to join your quest.
summary:
Embark on an Epic Adventure in Artifact Seeker: Paladin!

Enter a chaotic land as Amelia, the last Paladin, in Artifact Seeker: Paladin, a thrilling blend of RPG, roguelite, and action. Search for forgotten artifacts, engage in fierce battles, and uncover a captivating story.

Amelia, a paragon of Holy magic and masterful counter-defensive tactics, stands as a beacon of hope. Her resilience on the battlefield is legendary; she rises from adversity to protect her allies with unwavering faith and sacred power. Experience her unique playstyle in this exciting adventure game.
